notes: TBox contraction paired with history-replace-0008: removes the revision's original rule (every ancient Egyptian obelisk was carved from a single block of stone). The derived queries name the Flaminio Obelisk, the obelisk of Senusret I at Heliopolis and the Boboli obelisk as ancient Egyptian obelisks and ask how many pieces of stone each was made from (the Flaminio question says 'originally carved from', since it was later found broken in pieces and re-erected). Direct, paraphrase and cross-lingual questions keep the revision's single-block-or-stacked choices. The negation is worded 'Is it true that ... were not ...?'. Near, far and side facts are the revision's.
